name: Skins are look only
author: wizard
description: Skins become a look only. Your own skin stops deciding which features run: only the feature switches here and in the WizardOS Tracker do, the same for every tester. Turning this on carries the choices of the own skin you're wearing into those switches once. Tweaks on the drop list (Two orbs, App borders, No close on desks, Pin buttons, WizardOS name) are off. Skin scripts are paused. Your skin's saved choices and script approval are kept and come back when you switch this off.
